train_caps_basis: Train rows per stratum (family/task/type). Fable 2026-10-03 under the human's budget lift ("I don't care about budget if it's gonna be a great model"): every admitted row that passes the label rules, except two redundancy caps. Open-Jev NLI is capped at 5,000 rows. Procedural is capped at 4,000 per stratum, a seeded draw within each of its 25 task x type strata. Open-Jev strata are keyed by domain (openjev.<family>/<domain>/<type>; Fable 2026-10-03), a reporting level: they are all-admitted, so no number moves. The other numbers are each stratum's whole train availability after decontamination, as qd-prep decisions counted it. If an availability grows, the build takes only the listed number: the cap is a count, and a stratum missing from the table is refused. Pre-registered, report-only: per-stratum procedural val accuracy. At >= 99% v6 lowers the procedural cap; otherwise v6 raises it. A stratum the label rules empty is listed with cap 0 (qd-prep refuses a non-zero cap naming no stratum): procedural.decisions/partial_observation_calibration/yesno is empty because its answers are all fractional probabilities, refused as probability_question (lead review 2026-10-03). v3 (lead 2026-10-03): the share-alike sources the human admitted -- BoolQ and ARC (Challenge and Easy) train, every row that passes the rules; VitaminC capped at 0 by default, because every row carries big_bench_canary, a marker its authors use for data to keep out of training corpora (the human decides; turning it on is this one cap, at most 5,000 seeded, the Open-Jev NLI redundancy cap). v4 (the human, 2026-10-03 ~18:42Z, lead session: "Yes to all, waive R9, approve ~$400"; AUDIT/finalize-2026-10-03/human-answers-2026-10-03-v5-launch.md): VitaminC is in, at 5,000 seeded rows, the cap named above. Its rows carry big_bench_canary; that the GUID is BIG-bench's is [U], and the field is never read into a row. A model trained on it is contaminated for any BIG-bench task built from VitaminC. vitaminc.nli now has val rows like every trained family. BoolQ validation (boolq-val) and VitaminC test (vitaminc-test) are enforced decontamination targets beside arc-test, each the item's own text. v4 refresh, mechanical (qd-prep decision-caps, decisions::refresh_train_caps): a cap that equalled its stratum's train availability in the v3 survey becomes that stratum's availability in the v4 survey (the Open-Jev val draw keyed on the scene; the boolq-val and vitaminc-test targets); every other cap -- the redundancy caps and the 0s -- is untouched, and no cap is set by hand. 36 moved, BoolQ 8,975 -> 7,345 among them (lead, 2026-10-03: accepted; the human approved boolq-val as an enforced target).
